style: Warm 3D digital storybook animation style with rich vibrant colors, gentle cinematic lighting, soft hand-painted textures, whimsical magical atmosphere, and charming rounded character designs.

characters.name: Mithi
characters.look: A cute 6-year-old Indian village girl with big sparkling dark brown eyes, rosy cheeks, and black hair tied into two braided pigtails with bright red ribbons. She wears a bright mustard-yellow cotton kurti with small printed flowers and olive-green bottoms.

characters.name: Papa
characters.look: A hardworking 40-year-old Indian potter with a kind face, gentle eye wrinkles, a thick dark mustache, and short messy black hair mixed with gray. He wears a beige khadi cotton kurta smudged with dried grey clay, rolled-up sleeves, and a traditional dark brown dhoti.

characters.name: Uluka
characters.look: A beautiful magical white barn owl with large glowing amber eyes, soft fluffy snow-white feathers with faint glowing golden specks, a heart-shaped facial disc, and tiny neat talons.

locations.look: Rustic Indian village pottery shop with textured mud walls, an earthen floor, a traditional stone potter's wheel, stacks of fresh wet clay, and wooden shelves filled with terracotta clay pots and diyas.
A cozy village home courtyard featuring terracotta tile ground, smooth whitewashed mud walls, decorative traditional floral rangoli patterns on the floor, and small potted plants.
A festive Indian village street during Diwali night, with cozy mud-brick houses decorated with sparkling festive lights, colorful rangoli at doorways, and a warm magical glow.
